visual_review.review_method: Agent inspection of actual decoded source/model frames; sampled visual review, not frame-by-frame certification.

variant-0000.name: Cool twilight gray
variant-0000.observations: A cool blue illumination change is visible throughout the sampled frames. Broad arm/action progression and visible cup transparency remain. Small gripper plate details and markings differ; exact contact fidelity is unverified.

variant-0001.name: Brushed aluminum / lab
variant-0001.observations: Tabletop reflectance changes visibly, especially the stronger lower-left highlight. Fine brushing is not clearly resolved at review scale. Robot rods become brighter under the requested relighting; small gripper plate markings also differ. Broad action progression is retained, but exact contacts remain unverified.

variant-0002.name: Black rubber / softbox
variant-0002.observations: The tabletop becomes darker and less reflective, although rubber identity is subtle compared with the already gray source. Faint additional tabletop patterns appear in the upper-right area. Broad arm/action progression is retained; gripper plate details differ and small contacts remain unverified.

variant-0003.name: Walnut / warm studio
variant-0003.observations: Warm brown tabletop and visible wood-like grain appear throughout the sampled frames, going beyond a uniform color change. Broad arm/action progression and clear plastic remain visible. Gripper plate markings change and the straight tabletop strip loses contrast; exact small contacts remain unverified.

variant-0004.name: Terracotta / side light
variant-0004.observations: The tabletop becomes orange-brown with fine texture and broad directional shadows. Warm illumination substantially changes scene contrast. Broad arm/action progression and visible clear plastic remain, while small gripper markings differ; fine pores and exact grasp contacts are not established at this review scale.

variant-0005.name: Warm side-lit gray
variant-0005.observations: The gray tabletop is retained with a warm left-side light gradient and much longer, soft robot shadows. This demonstrates relighting beyond a tabletop color substitution. Broad arm/action progression remains, but small gripper markings and plate details change; exact contact fidelity remains unverified.

variant-0006.name: Cork / diffuse daylight
variant-0006.observations: Tan cork-like texture is concentrated in a lower band, with a pronounced horizontal appearance boundary and a largely gray upper tabletop. This does not consistently realize the requested full-table cork under diffuse light. Broad arm/action progression remains; gripper details differ and exact contacts remain unverified.

variant-0007.name: Green laminate / soft daylight
variant-0007.observations: Muted green is visible across the lower tabletop while a large pale upper region remains. Fine grain is visible despite the requested uniform laminate finish; the straight white strip becomes lower-contrast. Broad arm/action progression and clear plastic remain visible, but small gripper details and contacts are not faithfully established.

variant-0008.name: Granite / overcast
variant-0008.observations: A fine, stone-like speckled gray texture covers the tabletop throughout the sampled frames. This is a visible texture change beyond a color cast. Broad arm/action progression and transparent plastic remain visible, but small robot plate details and markings differ; exact contacts are not verified.

variant-0009.name: Pale oak / daylight
variant-0009.observations: Pale wood with visible lengthwise grain covers the tabletop throughout the sampled frames. Broad arm/action progression remains and the cup is still visibly transparent. Lighting is cooler on the robot than in the source, the straight white strip loses contrast, and small gripper details change; exact contacts remain unverified.

variant-0010.name: Stainless steel / cool lab
variant-0010.observations: The scene becomes cool blue-gray and darker with soft broad highlights. At this scale the tabletop does not unambiguously read as stainless steel; much of the change resembles relighting. Broad arm/action progression remains, but the straight strip loses contrast and small gripper details change; exact contacts remain unverified.

variant-0011.name: White ceramic / bright lab
variant-0011.observations: A bright lower-left highlight appears, but most of the tabletop remains dark gray or blue-gray instead of the requested ivory-white ceramic. The material request is therefore weakly realized in these frames. Broad arm/action progression and clear plastic remain visible, while small gripper details and markings differ; exact contacts remain unverified.

overview_video.processing: Resized decoded source/output frames, arranged with static labels; no scene retouching.
